why_a_separate_file: That spec is hashed into experiments/peer_claims_v3/freeze.json, so editing it in place would break verify_freeze() and destroy the provenance the freeze exists to protect. The spec's own acquisition field anticipates this and instructs: 'Record repository revision and file SHA-256 at download time as an amendment.' This is that amendment.
limitation: This pins the file that is on disk now; it does not establish that this file is what the frozen repository reference would produce today. The GGUF is a third-party quantization from bartowski/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-GGUF with revision recorded as null, so there is no upstream revision to reproduce it from. Unlike the qwen3 checkpoint -- which was reproduced from pinned inputs and matched bit for bit -- this one is trusted as downloaded. Any cross-checkpoint claim that rests on it inherits that weaker provenance and must say so.
consequence_for_runs: serve_v3_cpu.py only asserts the digest when the spec carries a gguf_sha256, and the frozen spec carries null, so llama31_8b runs are NOT hash-gated at launch. The digest above is the reference to compare against results/peer_claims_v3/llama31_8b_server.json's resolved_gguf_sha256 by hand after each run.
